name: Shepr
author: nixfred
description: Shows which herdr agent sessions are waiting on you, and pairs your iPhone with Shepr, the home-screen app that reads and answers them. A bar badge, a waiting list and a pairing QR.

barWidget.description: A dot and the number of agent sessions waiting on you. Click for the list, the Shepr address and a QR that pairs a phone.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the badge asks herdr how many sessions are waiting. It only reads.

schema.label: Show the number on the bar
schema.description: The waiting count beside the dot. Off leaves just the dot.
